title: The Reconciliation Canopy

features.name: root-learning-sky
features.desc-on-touch: Where root emerges as branch. The distinction between down and up collapses here. You can feel both growing toward each other.

features.name: the-bidirectional-sap
features.desc-on-touch: Flow that moves both ways through the same vessel. What the root sent up now returns from the sky. The plant learned that up and down are the same conversation.

features.name: convergence-listening
features.desc-on-touch: A meeting place where root-silence and sky-sound arrive at once. They do not cancel each other. Instead they create a new tone: neither root nor sky, but both.

features.name: the-embrace-circuit
features.desc-on-touch: Branches and rootlets intertwine in a pattern the tree did not choose. The growth chose itself. You can trace the path where the two learned to hold each other.

features.name: the-undone-division
features.desc-on-touch: Here is the place where 'root' and 'sky' were a single word before they learned to be different things. They are remembering how to be that word again.

inscription: where root and sky learned they were speaking the same language but had forgotten how to listen

file.name: Root_Sky_Convergence_Study_Ring_Analysis.txt
file.note: The rings at this canopy show simultaneous growth in opposite directions—evidence of reconciliation rendered in wood.
